name: AI Pose Gallery
tagline: A free library of 1,439 body-pose reference images you can browse, filter by angle, and use for AI art.
sentence: Open a website, pick a pose and a camera angle, and download a clean line drawing ready to feed into an image generator - 288 poses across 5 viewing angles, no account needed.

visual.alt: The Pose Atlas gallery interface showing 288 pose groups with 1,439 reference images and 5 viewing angles. Thumbnails of human figure line drawings are laid out in a grid, with category tabs at the top for full-body, upper-body, and two-person poses.
visual.caption: Browse 288 poses by category and angle - each one is a clean line drawing at 900 x 1,200 pixels.

board.say: You need a body reference image for an AI art prompt, but searching the web gives you inconsistent styles and angles.
You open the Pose Atlas website in your browser.
A rough idea of the pose you want - standing, leaning, sitting - and the camera angle you need.
The gallery filters its 288 pose groups by your criteria.
steps: Shows thumbnails sorted by category: full-body, upper-body, or two-person poses
Lets you filter by 5 viewing angles: front, oblique, side, top-down, and bottom-up
Click a thumbnail to see the full 900 x 1,200 pixel original

board.say: A clean line drawing you can use as a reference.

outputs.eg: A 900 x 1,200 PNG line drawing of a standing figure with arms crossed, viewed from the front
Pose P001 with its Chinese and original Japanese name, so you can find it again

before: Searching Google or Pinterest for body reference gives you a mix of photos, sketches, and 3D renders in different styles
Hard to find the same pose from multiple camera angles
Free reference sites are scattered and require accounts or downloads
after: One site with 288 poses in a consistent line-drawing style, each in up to 5 camera angles
Browse and download originals without an account - nothing extra to install
Every image is a clean line drawing at 900 x 1,200 pixels, ready for AI image generation
uses_note: AI Pose Gallery is 3 days old. It is a Chinese translation of the original Japanese AI Pose Gallery by @giaaibusi. No independent use reports found yet.

steps: [Open the gallery](https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/) in your browser - no install needed
Use the category tabs at the top (full-body, upper-body, two-person) and the angle filters (front, oblique, side, top-down, bottom-up) to find a pose
Click a thumbnail to see the full 900 x 1,200 pixel original, then right-click to save or copy the image for your AI art prompt
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh
Then: Clone the repo and open index.html with a local server (python3 -m http.server 8000). Browse the poses and try the agent skills in the skills/ folder.

footprint.disk: The full repo with all images is about 660 MB. The site itself (HTML, CSS, JSON) is under 1 MB - the images are the bulk.
footprint.memory: Runs in a browser tab - no special memory needs.
footprint.runs_on: Any device with a web browser. For local hosting: Python 3 (for the built-in server) or any static file host.

best_for: Artists who use AI image generators and need consistent body-pose references
Anyone making character art who wants clean, angle-matched reference drawings
skip_if: You don't read Chinese (the interface and labels are entirely in Chinese)
You need photographic references rather than line drawings
You need poses beyond the 288 included (no upload or custom pose creation)

alternatives.name: PoseMyArt
alternatives.line: A 3D pose tool where you drag a mannequin into any position and export a reference image

watch: **The interface is entirely in Chinese.** Every label, category name, and description is in Chinese. The poses themselves are universal line drawings, but navigating the site requires some comfort with Chinese text or a browser translator.
**Three days old.** The project launched on Oct 27, 2026 and has no tagged releases, version numbers, or changelog.
**Images are not freely licensed.** The MIT license covers only the scripts and HTML. The images and data belong to the original author (@giaaibusi) and are not licensed for commercial use.
**Adult content warning.** Some pose categories include artistic nudity and intimate two-person poses.
